title: WordTaste plan
description: The plan a planner returns for one Chinese long-form essay. Every Chinese string in it is copied character for character from the human material; everything the planner says in its own words is English, in notes_en. open_question is the one exception: it is shown to the user and never composed into a prompt.

title.description: The essay title, verbatim from the material.

claims.description: The argument as individually addressable claims.

source.description: Where it came from: materials/original.md or materials/outline.md, optionally with a line anchor such as #L12.

units.description: Sequential writing units, normally 600-1200 Chinese characters, grouped by content rather than by capacity.

id.description: u1, u2, ... — unique within the plan.

role.description: What this unit does in the essay. Assigned before length or pace; the prose form follows from it.

spans.description: Heading-to-heading ranges of a material file. The range starts at the from line and ends before the to line; an empty to means end of file.

file.description: A material file path relative to the content set, such as materials/original.md.

from.description: A whole line of that file, copied exactly.

to.description: A whole line of that file after from, copied exactly, or empty for end of file.

must_keep.description: Sentences whose meaning must survive, verbatim from the spanned material.

target_chars.description: A rough length in Chinese characters, not a threshold to hit.

pace.description: How tightly this unit is packed. Neighbouring units change gear.

ends.description: stop: the unit ends and says nothing more. open: it leaves the reader waiting for the next unit.

notes_en.description: English only. Anything the planner wants to tell the writer in its own words belongs here and nowhere else.

opens_section.description: Optional, default false. True when this unit opens a new section of the essay; the writer then gives that section a heading of its own. You decide where sections begin, not what they are called — the heading is Chinese, and Chinese you wrote is not allowed in a plan. Use it sparingly: a heading before every unit is the same as no headings at all. The first unit is already the opening and its first line is the title, so the flag is ignored there.

open_question.description: Optional. One question for the user, Chinese allowed. It is shown to the user and never composed into a prompt.
